posts.title: SEC Championship Game scenarios: How Texas clinched a spot against Georgia
posts.description: (Photo by Jeffrey Vest/Icon Sportswire via Getty Images) | Icon Sportswire via Getty Images Update: With Ole Miss beating Mississippi State, and Texas beating Texas A&M, the Longhorns have clinched a spot in the SEC Championship Game. One spot in the final SEC Championship Game is set. But who will Georgia play next weekend in Atlanta? With the college football world moving to a 24-game playoff next season, the Power 4 conferences have already declared that this year’s round of conference championship games will be the last. That means the winner of the SEC Championship Game this year will have bragging rights for the near future, or until the sport changes yet again. Georgia has already clinched one spot in that game, but who will take on the Bulldogs in Atlanta? As Rivalry Week begins three teams — Texas, Tennessee, and Alabama — are fighting for that final spot. Here is how each can book a ticket to Atlanta. posts.title: What is Scorigami, and how many will we see in the 2026 NFL season?
posts.description: (Photo by Stacy Revere/Getty Images) | Getty Images There had been 1095 unique final scores in NFL history as of the conclusion of the 2025 season. We are now up to 1102 with the ones added during 2026. With teams scoring more points in games, the extra point moving out to a 33-yard kick, and teams deciding to go for two more often to gain edges, never-before-seen final scores are still happening despite the NFL playing for more than 100 years. These unique scores are also called “Scorigami”. Many of the Scorigami we are seeing are for 40-plus point games that have high scoring from both teams, but we’ve also been seeing scores in the 30s that have never happened. It’s not just high scores that have never happened, though. A game has never finished in a 2-2 tie, for instance. The NFL didn’t allow two-point conversions until 1994, and we’ve never seen an 8-7 game. A game has never ended in a 9-9 tie, among other scores still out there. posts.title: NFL playoff picture: Steelers boost chances with Week 12 win over Broncos
posts.description: (Photo by Justin K. Aller/Getty Images) | Getty Images The Pittsburgh Steelers overcame a wild week of Aaron Rodgers hubbub to beat the Denver Broncos 27-5 on Black Friday and boost their playoff chances. Pittsburgh improved to 7-4 with the win while Denver dropped to 8-3 with the loss. Heading into the game, most of the chatter was around the release of Aaron Rodgers. The Steelers released the QB after he blasted head coach Mike McCarthy on Wednesday. That meant Mason Rudolph was getting the start at home against Bo Nix and the favored Broncos. The Steelers won primarily due to their defense, scoring two defensive touchdowns while Nix struggled all afternoon. Pittsburgh moved up the playoff standings with the win, climbing into sixth place for the time-being. They are a half game up on the Browns for the second wild card berth, pending the outcome of the Browns home game against the Raiders this weekend on Sunday Night Football .
